anchoring_rule: after+G4(before-after) at half resolution, no profile/force/guide change, final balanced exchanges fixed
factorial: small forms: point and truncated Gaussian widths0.7/1.5/3; amplitudes3/6/10 times own-plane HH(D); separate positive Y/Co/Cg injections
limitations: cross target is noisy: loss is NOT clean MSE; debiased risk conditional on equal independent zero-mean noise and stable signal, can be negative; selection uses both frames and can bias conditional risk; reinjection uses centered differential D, loses marginal skew and FPN, not RAW simulation

rules: one median spatial-rank304px patch per mean-Y bin; G2 gradient<3 HH(DY); global/local exposure drift<=2%; own-A profile frozen and fixed1/1/2 stable-balanced, no guard, no profile reestimation
small_form_rules: own-A full-frame P frozen; representativeY frozen to flat mean; same centered differential noise in flat and injected renders; response=filtered(injected)-filtered(flat); ratios are response, not probability; common native Oklab mask intersection truth/input/output/flatOutput; spatial scales not measured on masked data
stage_rules: amplitudes6/10 only; stage images lifted to native geometry with INTER_LINEAR; matched flat/injected stage responses; area/median/blocks/guided/candidate-with-fine/balanced plus separate fine-residual/fine-retained; balanced values match final output; unavailable planes have no stage records
units: linear Rec.2020 Y/Co/Cg; squared errors in plane units squared; cross-prediction target is noisy, reinjection target is constructed
